note: A small enclosed public place containing a telephone; less common since mobile phones became widespread.

senses.m: A small enclosed public place containing a telephone
senses.pat: use a phone booth · a red phone booth · public phone booth
ex: He called for a taxi from a phone booth.
Anh gọi taxi từ một bốt điện thoại công cộng.
The old phone booth now houses a defibrillator.
Bốt điện thoại cũ nay đặt một máy khử rung tim.

note: Treatment using exercise and movement to improve function or reduce pain after illness or injury; called physiotherapy in many countries.

senses.m: Treatment using exercise and movement to improve function or reduce pain after illness or injury
senses.pat: receive physical therapy · physical-therapy session · physical therapist
ex: She began physical therapy after knee surgery.
Cô bắt đầu vật lý trị liệu sau ca phẫu thuật đầu gối.
The therapist designed exercises to restore shoulder movement.
Chuyên viên trị liệu thiết kế bài tập phục hồi vận động vai.

note: High-tensile steel wire used in pianos and other applications; also called music wire.

senses.m: High-tensile steel wire used in pianos and other applications
senses.pat: a length of piano wire · piano-wire string · cut piano wire
ex: The piano technician replaced a broken piano wire.
Kỹ thuật viên đàn piano thay dây đàn bị đứt.
The wire is used in precision springs as well as instruments.
Loại dây này được dùng làm lò xo chính xác và nhạc cụ.

note: Crude iron produced by smelting iron ore in a blast furnace, used as an intermediate material for steelmaking or casting.

senses.m: Crude iron produced by smelting iron ore in a blast furnace, used as an intermediate material for steelmaking or casting
senses.pat: produce pig iron · pig-iron production · molten pig iron
ex: The plant produces pig iron for steelmaking.
Nhà máy sản xuất gang thỏi để luyện thép.
Molten pig iron was poured into molds.
Gang nóng chảy được rót vào khuôn.

note: A machine that drives piles into the ground to support structures; also a powerful downward wrestling move.

senses.m: A machine that drives piles into the ground to support structures
senses.pat: operate a pile driver · a hydraulic pile driver · use a pile driver
ex: A pile driver installed foundations for the bridge.
Máy đóng cọc thi công móng cho cây cầu.
The wrestler won with a pile driver move.
Đô vật giành chiến thắng bằng đòn pile driver.

note: A small amount of money for personal or incidental expenses, traditionally given to a woman; dated and gendered in origin.

senses.m: A small amount of money for personal or incidental expenses, traditionally given to a woman
senses.pat: earn a little pin money · use something as pin money · pin-money income
ex: She sold crafts online to earn a little pin money.
Cô bán đồ thủ công trực tuyến để kiếm thêm chút tiền tiêu riêng.
The phrase pin money is now considered old-fashioned.
Cụm pin money nay được xem là lỗi thời.

note: Angry or annoyed; informal and potentially offensive, especially in formal settings. In British English, pissed can also mean drunk.

senses.m: Angry or annoyed
senses.pat: get/be pissed off with · really pissed off · piss someone off
ex: He was pissed off about the cancelled flight.
Anh bực mình vì chuyến bay bị hủy.
The delay really pissed her off.
Sự chậm trễ khiến cô ấy rất tức giận.

note: A brief stop during a journey, race, or activity; originally a stop in a racing pit for service.

senses.m: A brief stop during a journey, race, or activity
senses.pat: make a pit stop · quick pit stop · pit-stop crew
ex: We made a pit stop to refuel and stretch our legs.
Chúng tôi dừng nhanh để đổ xăng và duỗi chân.
The racing team completed the pit stop in seconds.
Đội đua hoàn tất lượt dừng kỹ thuật chỉ trong vài giây.

note: A small device that produces a reference musical pitch for tuning or starting a song.

senses.m: A small device that produces a reference musical pitch for tuning or starting a song
senses.pat: blow a pitch pipe · pitch-pipe note · tune from a pitch pipe
ex: The choir director sounded a pitch pipe before rehearsal.
Người chỉ huy hợp xướng thổi ống chuẩn âm trước buổi tập.
She used a pitch pipe to find the starting note.
Cô dùng ống chuẩn âm để lấy nốt bắt đầu.

note: The dishes, cutlery, and glass arranged for one person at a meal.

senses.m: The dishes, cutlery, and glass arranged for one person at a meal
senses.pat: set a place setting · a formal place setting · arrange place settings
ex: Each place setting included a plate, fork, and glass.
Mỗi bộ đồ ăn có một chiếc đĩa, nĩa và ly.
The host arranged six place settings around the table.
Chủ nhà sắp xếp sáu bộ đồ ăn quanh bàn.

note: Ordinary clothes worn instead of a uniform; plainclothes is often an adjective, as in plainclothes officer.

senses.m: Ordinary clothes worn instead of a uniform
senses.pat: in plain clothes · plainclothes detective · wear plain clothes
ex: The officers were in plain clothes during the investigation.
Các sĩ quan mặc thường phục trong cuộc điều tra.
A plainclothes detective questioned the witness.
Một điều tra viên mặc thường phục hỏi nhân chứng.

note: A doctor specializing in surgery that reconstructs, repairs, or changes body tissues; plastic refers to shaping, not plastic material.

senses.m: A doctor specializing in surgery that reconstructs, repairs, or changes body tissues
senses.pat: consult a plastic surgeon · reconstructive plastic surgeon · plastic-surgery specialist
ex: The plastic surgeon repaired tissue damaged in the accident.
Bác sĩ phẫu thuật tạo hình tái tạo mô bị tổn thương trong tai nạn.
She consulted a plastic surgeon about reconstructive options.
Cô tham khảo ý kiến bác sĩ phẫu thuật tạo hình về các lựa chọn tái tạo.

note: Surgery that reconstructs, repairs, or alters body tissues; includes reconstructive and cosmetic procedures, which have different aims.

senses.m: Surgery that reconstructs, repairs, or alters body tissues
senses.pat: undergo plastic surgery · reconstructive plastic surgery · plastic-surgery procedure
ex: Plastic surgery helped restore movement after the injury.
Phẫu thuật tạo hình giúp phục hồi khả năng vận động sau chấn thương.
The clinic distinguishes reconstructive from cosmetic plastic surgery.
Phòng khám phân biệt phẫu thuật tạo hình tái tạo với phẫu thuật thẩm mỹ.

note: Thin flexible plastic film used to cover or wrap food; also called cling film in British English.

senses.m: Thin flexible plastic film used to cover or wrap food
senses.pat: cover food with plastic wrap · a roll of plastic wrap · plastic-wrap film
ex: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap before refrigerating it.
Đậy tô bằng màng bọc thực phẩm trước khi cho vào tủ lạnh.
Cling film is the usual British term for plastic wrap.
Cling film là cách gọi phổ biến ở Anh của màng bọc thực phẩm.

note: A thick, flat sheet of glass, historically made by polishing; now commonly refers to large flat glass panes.

senses.m: A thick, flat sheet of glass, historically made by polishing
senses.pat: a plate-glass window · plate-glass door · large plate glass
ex: The storefront has a plate-glass window.
Mặt tiền cửa hàng có cửa sổ kính tấm lớn.
The builders replaced the cracked plate glass.
Thợ xây thay tấm kính phẳng bị nứt.

note: A piano that plays music automatically using a mechanism, historically controlled by a perforated paper roll; also called a pianola.

senses.m: A piano that plays music automatically using a mechanism, historically controlled by a perforated paper roll
senses.pat: a player piano plays · restore a player piano · player-piano roll
ex: The old player piano performed a tune from a paper roll.
Chiếc đàn piano tự chơi cũ phát một giai điệu từ cuộn giấy đục lỗ.
The museum restored a player piano from the 1920s.
Bảo tàng phục chế một cây đàn piano tự chơi từ thập niên 1920.

note: A substance intended to cause death or serious harm; figuratively, a measure designed to make a takeover or proposal unattractive or difficult. Context distinguishes literal and business uses.

senses.m: A substance intended to cause death or serious harm
senses.pat: a poison pill policy · include a poison pill clause · swallow a poison pill
ex: The contract included a poison pill clause to deter a takeover.
Hợp đồng có điều khoản chống thâu tóm nhằm ngăn thương vụ mua lại.
The cabinet rejected the proposal as a political poison pill.
Nội các bác bỏ đề xuất vì cho rằng đó là lựa chọn chính trị tai hại.

note: A person imprisoned primarily for political reasons, such as opposing a government; classification can be disputed and should be attributed where contested.

senses.m: A person imprisoned primarily for political reasons, such as opposing a government
senses.pat: release political prisoners · be held as a political prisoner · political-prisoner status
ex: The organization called for the release of political prisoners.
Tổ chức kêu gọi thả các tù nhân chính trị.
The government denied that the detainees were political prisoners.
Chính phủ phủ nhận những người bị giam là tù nhân chính trị.

note: A scholar who studies politics, government, and political behavior; not necessarily a politician.

senses.m: A scholar who studies politics, government, and political behavior
senses.pat: a political scientist studies · political-science professor · ask a political scientist
ex: The political scientist analyzed voter turnout.
Nhà khoa học chính trị phân tích tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu.
She is a political scientist at the university.
Bà là nhà khoa học chính trị tại trường đại học.

note: A coalition of political groups, often left-wing, formed against a shared opponent; historical and country-specific meaning varies.

senses.m: A coalition of political groups, often left-wing, formed against a shared opponent
senses.pat: form a popular front · Popular Front coalition · popular-front government
ex: Several parties formed a popular front before the election.
Một số đảng thành lập mặt trận bình dân trước cuộc bầu cử.
The historian studied the Popular Front in 1930s France.
Nhà sử học nghiên cứu Mặt trận Bình dân ở Pháp thập niên 1930.
